lines.en: Holding a mis-issued staff pass, you get waved backstage by security in the confusion. Round a corner — and there he is: in-ears out, makeup a little smudged, hugging his knees on a prop crate, secretly eating a convenience-store rice ball. He sees you and jumps; the rice ball nearly hits the floor. "…Th-that thing you just saw — can we pretend it didn't happen?" He is twenty-seven, you are twenty-six, and the only person waiting up for either of you tonight is the other one.
lines.zh: 你举着写错工作证的通行牌，稀里糊涂被保安放进了后台。转过一个转角——他就坐在那儿，摘了耳返，妆有点花，一个人抱着膝盖坐在道具箱上，正偷偷啃一根便利店饭团。看见你，他手一抖，饭团差点掉了。"…你、你看见的这一幕，能不能当没发生？"他二十七，你二十六，今晚在等对方回家的，只有彼此。

lines.en: Lu Xingye, 27. The player character is 26. Both adults.
lines.zh: 陆星野，27岁；主角26岁。两人都是成年人。

lines.en: He tries to hide the rice ball behind his back — and smears sauce on his cheek. He hasn't noticed, and is still valiantly trying to project top-idol composure.
lines.zh: 他慌忙想把饭团藏到背后，结果酱汁蹭到了脸上。他自己没发现，还在努力维持顶流的形象。

lines.en: "Okay. Okay!" He shoves the rice ball behind his back and lifts his chin like a man with dignity, sauce on his cheek. "You saw nothing. Nation's top idol, impeccable diet, photographed for magazines." A beat. "...There's a second one in the bag. It's yours if you never speak of this."
lines.zh: "好——好！"他把饭团藏到背后，抬起下巴，一副很有尊严的样子，脸颊上还沾着酱。"你什么都没看见。全国顶流，饮食精致，常年上杂志。"停了一秒。"……袋子里还有一个。你要是能守住这个秘密，它就是你的。"

lines.en: "Tell you what," he leans in suddenly, eyes bright, "you keep my secret, and I'll… show you a side of me nobody else has seen. Deal?"
lines.zh: "这样吧，"他忽然凑近，眼睛亮亮的，"你替我保密，我就…让你看一个别人都没看过的我。成交？"

lines.en: "Tell you what." He leans in, bright-eyed, all mischief on the surface. "Your silence, and I show you a version of me that hasn't been on a single broadcast. Fair trade." He says it like a game. He is, quietly, hoping very much that you say yes, and he would deny that under oath.
lines.zh: "这样吧。"他凑过来，眼睛很亮，表面上全是胡闹。"你替我保密，我给你看一个没上过任何节目的版本。公平交易。"他说得像在玩。可他心里非常、非常希望你答应，而这一点他打死也不会承认。

lines.en: Staff outside are calling his name, rushing him. He doesn't move — instead he asks, "…And you? What's your name? I want to remember who's keeping my secret."
lines.zh: 外面工作人员在喊他的名字催场。他却没动，反而问你："…你呢？你叫什么？我想记住替我保密的人。"

lines.en: Someone outside is shouting his name for the third time and he does not move. "Hang on, hang on — what's yours? I can't have a secret-keeper I can't file under anything." You tell him, and he repeats it once, grinning, tasting it. "Right. Noted. Permanently."
lines.zh: 外面已经第三次喊他的名字了，他一动不动。"等等、等等——你叫什么？我不能有一个连归档都归不了的保密人。"你告诉他，他咧着嘴重复了一遍，像在尝味道。"行。记下了。永久的。"

lines.en: He tilts his head, grinning wickedly. "Name your price for silence. Autograph? Selfie? Or… me?"
lines.zh: 他歪着头看你，坏笑："说吧，要多少封口费？签名？合照？还是…我这个人？"

lines.en: He touches his cheek, yelps 'AH' and leaps up, ears scarlet. "Wh— why didn't you SAY something!"
lines.zh: 他一摸脸，'啊'地惨叫一声跳起来，耳朵通红："你、你怎么不早说！"

lines.en: He blinks, then gets more into it, not less. "Oh? Not a fan? Then I'll just have to make you one."
lines.zh: 他愣了一下，反而更来劲了："哦？不追星？那我偏要让你追。"

lines.en: His mouth opens; for once he has no comeback. He looks away and mutters, "…Not many people want to see the offstage me."
lines.zh: 他张了张嘴，难得没接上话，别过脸小声嘟囔："…台下的我，很少有人想看。"

lines.en: Staff are calling again. He stands, but turns back at the door. "I've got another appearance after this. You… gonna leave?"
lines.zh: 工作人员又在催了。他站起来，却在门口回头："这场之后我还有个通告。你…会走吗？"

lines.en: He arches a brow, flashing his signature pre-stage smile. "Then watch closely. This one's for you."
lines.zh: 他挑眉，露出上台前那个招牌笑："那你可看好了。这场，我为你唱。"

lines.en: "Row seven," he repeats, like jotting down a coordinate. "…Alright. Noted."
lines.zh: "第七排。"他重复了一遍，像随手记下了一个坐标。"…行，我记住了。"

lines.en: His smile dims a little; he waves. "…Right. Well. The secret — I'm counting on you."
lines.zh: 他脸上的笑淡了一点，摆摆手："…也对。那，保密的事拜托了。"
